status.label: No bug fix proposed
status.detail: Live folder monitoring is an enhancement requiring product scope.

judgment.rationale: This is a new workflow capability rather than a defect in the documented rename operation. Current PowerRename has no file-system watcher for its item collection, and the issue was filed using the feature/enhancement template despite carrying an Issue-Bug label.
evidence: The body is explicitly framed as “Description of the new feature / enhancement.”
The scenario is generated data whose filenames change while PowerRename remains open.
No reproduction of incorrect existing behavior, comments, linked work, or ownership evidence is supplied.
judgment.recommended_action: Reclassify as an enhancement and require product behavior decisions before implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing PowerToys bug is established; adding live folder monitoring is a feature with scope, performance, and selection-semantics decisions.

issue_context.summary: The request asks PowerRename to monitor a folder and dynamically add or remove files while its window stays open after a rename operation.
known_information: The desired behavior is for the open PowerRename list to reflect files added or removed from the folder.
The current option to remain open after renaming does not promise live folder monitoring.
Current PowerRename source contains no folder FileSystemWatcher or ReadDirectoryChangesW path.
inferences: Implementing this safely would require decisions about recursive watching, selection retention, rename feedback loops, and high-churn folders.
issue_context.analysis: Treating this as a bug would prematurely imply a compatibility contract. It should enter normal feature planning with explicit scope and UX acceptance criteria.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live issue through 2023-02-09T16:53:30Z.
Searched current PowerRename source for FileSystemWatcher, ReadDirectoryChangesW, and folder-change refresh handling; none was found.
No comments, linked issues or PRs, or assignees appear in the timeline.

comment.body: This request describes a new live-folder workflow rather than a regression: keeping PowerRename open currently keeps the selected rename session open, but it does not promise to monitor the folder and add or remove items as files change. I suggest reclassifying this as an enhancement. Before implementation, the feature needs product decisions for recursive versus selected-folder monitoring, preserving selections and preview state, avoiding feedback loops from PowerRename’s own renames, and behavior in high-churn folders.
